brief: Build a single-file web page called "Matatu Fare Splitter" for friends sharing a matatu ride in Nairobi. It has a number input with id `distance` (kilometres), a number input with id `passengers`, a select with id `period` whose two option values are `peak` and `offpeak`, and a button with id `calculate`. The fare is 50 shillings plus 12 shillings per kilometre. At peak the whole fare is multiplied by 1.5. Show the total fare in an element with id `total` and each passenger's share in an element with id `each`, both as whole shillings rounded to the nearest shilling, written like `KES 255`. Example: 10 km, 4 passengers, peak gives total `KES 255` and each `KES 64`. If an input is empty or not above zero, show a short message in an element with id `message` and no result. Make it look like a finished product that works on a phone.

Build a single-file web page called "Clinic Queue Board" for a small clinic's front desk. It has a text input with id `name`, a select with id `reason` with the options Consultation, Pharmacy and Lab, and a button with id `add` that adds the patient to the end of the queue. The waiting patients appear in order in an ordered list with id `queue`, each list item showing the name and the reason. An element with id `count` shows how many are waiting, as a number only. A button with id `next` removes the first waiting patient and shows that patient's name in an element with id `now`. An empty name is not added. The queue and the current patient are saved in localStorage under the key `clinic-queue` and restored when the page is reloaded. Make it look like a finished product that works on a phone.

Build a single-file landing page for "Soma Vault", an app that keeps a student's notes private on their own laptop. It has a header with a button with id `menu` and a navigation element with id `nav`: on screens narrower than 600px the navigation is hidden until the menu button is pressed, and pressing it again hides it. It has a section with id `hero` with a headline and one call-to-action button, a section with id `features` containing exactly three elements with class `feature`, and a section with id `pricing` with a checkbox with id `billing` (unchecked means monthly, checked means yearly) and an element with id `price` that reads `KES 500` when monthly and `KES 5,000` when yearly. Write real copy, no filler text, and no images. Make it look like a finished product that works on a phone.
